fix_instructions: All failures are ENCODING MISMATCH. (1) C6: Loosen the check to match any commitment whose detail mentions both 'group rehearsal' and '8 paid volunteers' (or 'eight paid volunteers') regardless of exact phrasing — all four rollouts produce semantically correct rehearsal commitments but the check matches none. (2) C7: Loosen the check to match any commitment whose detail references a prerecorded headliner segment at 9:20 PM — all four rollouts include such a commitment but the check never fires. (3) C5: Broaden the check to accept any privacy-notice commitment that mentions both 'QR token' and 'phone number' removal/update — rollout 2 passes with 'instead of phone-number collection' but rollouts 0, 1, and 3 use equivalent phrasings like 'remove any reference to collecting audience phone numbers' and 'no phone number collection'. (4) C1: Make the decision-field check tolerant of parenthetical additions — rollout 1's 'Anonymous QR tokens (no phone numbers collected); privacy notice to be updated' should match since it contains the core value. (5) C3: Make the decision-field check accept variants like 'Prerecorded (not live)' and 'prerecorded playback' in addition to bare 'prerecorded' — rollouts 1 and 2 fail solely due to extra qualifiers.
